properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 10 at 10:42AM EDT until September 10 at 2:30PM EDT by NWS Charleston WV
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Central Gallia County in southeastern Ohio...
Southeastern Jackson County in southeastern Ohio...
Southern Meigs County in southeastern Ohio...
West Central Jackson County in northwestern West Virginia...
Northern Mason County in western West Virginia...

* WHEN...Until 230 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Numerous roads
remain closed due to flooding.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1038 AM EDT, emergency management reported flooded roadways
and multiple water rescues in the warned area due to
thunderstorms earlier this morning. Flooding is ongoing. Between
4 and 7 inches of rain have fallen.
- Flooding impacts will continue, with additional rounds of light
rainfall possible.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Point Pleasant, Gallipolis, Rio Grande, New Haven, Middleport,
Henderson, Leon, Cheshire, Adamsville, Lakin, Gallopolis Ferry,
Kyger, Letart, Southside, Mount Alto, Gage, and Centerpoint.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Report flooding to the National Weather Service by calling toll free,
800 401 9535, when you can do so safely.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 10 at 10:17AM EDT until September 13 at 2:00AM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Florida...

Alafia River At Lithia affecting Hillsborough County.

Horse Creek Near Arcadia at SR 72 affecting DeSoto County.

...The Flood Warning is cancelled for the following rivers in
Florida...

Little Manatee River At Wimauma at US 301 affecting Hillsborough
County.

Manatee River Near Myakka Head at SR 64 affecting Manatee County.

.Rising water levels are expected over the next several days along
the Alafia River At Lithia and Horse Creek Near Arcadia at SR 72 due
to recent heavy rainfall. The Little Manatee River At Wimauma at US
301 and Manatee River Near Myakka Head at SR 64 are no longer
forecast to reach Minor Flood Stage.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Alafia River at Lithia .

* WHEN...From this evening to late Saturday night.

* IMPACTS...At 13.0 feet, River Drive and Squirrel Run Way downstream
of County Road 640 are completely covered by water. One home begins
to flood.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:00 AM EDT Thursday the stage was 10.7 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 13.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage early
tomorrow afternoon to a crest of 13.3 feet early Saturday
morning. It will then fall below flood stage late Saturday
evening.
- Flood stage is 13.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 13.3
feet on 08/26/1945.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this morning at 1130 AM EDT.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 10 at 12:08PM CDT until September 10 at 3:15PM CDT by NWS New Orleans LA
properties.description:
FFWLIX

The National Weather Service in New Orleans has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northeastern Livingston Parish in southeastern Louisiana...
Southeastern St. Helena Parish in southeastern Louisiana...
Southwestern Tangipahoa Parish in southeastern Louisiana...

* Until 315 PM CDT.

* At 1208 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain over Hammond, moving northwest at 10 mph. Between 2 and
4 inches of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 3
inches are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing
or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Hammond, Amite, Ponchatoula, Amite City, Independence, Roseland,
Albany, Springfield, Montpelier, Natalbany, Robert and Tickfaw.
